title: Daily mean time series on a complete calendar with a broken line at gaps
source_relation: adapted: function-style contract, plot inspected through ggplot_build on withheld data
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents aggregate only the observed days (so geom_line interpolates across gaps), fill gaps with zero, or silence NA with na.rm = TRUE which silently joins the line; a day with readings but only missing scores is also easy to mis-handle.

mcp_relevance.rationale: The failure modes concern how ggplot2 treats NA in lines and how to build a complete calendar; they are semantic traps solvable from basic ggplot2 knowledge and local help. Nothing depends on a version-specific fact.
mcp_relevance.information_need: How geom_line handles NA and what na.rm does; building a complete Date sequence.
alternative_solution_paths: tapply over a factor of all calendar days
merge with a complete calendar data frame

calibration_risks.ceiling: moderate-high: a familiar pattern for strong models

pinned_evidence.oracle: tapply of daily means over the full calendar; plot inspected through ggplot_build (layer data, geom params, scales, labels)
